import settings


def test_daily_count_is_2():
    assert settings.LEARNING_CONFIG['daily_count'] == 2


def test_wechat_work_config_exists():
    assert hasattr(settings, 'WECHAT_WORK_CONFIG')
    assert isinstance(settings.WECHAT_WORK_CONFIG, dict)


def test_wechat_work_config_fields():
    cfg = settings.WECHAT_WORK_CONFIG
    assert cfg['enabled'] is True
    assert 'webhook_url' in cfg and cfg['webhook_url'].startswith('http/workspace/')
    assert cfg['msg_type'] == 'markdown'
    assert cfg['use_email'] is False


def test_smtp_config_unchanged():
    assert settings.SMTP_CONFIG['host'] == 'smtp.qq.com'
    assert settings.SMTP_CONFIG['port'] == 465
    assert settings.SMTP_CONFIG['use_tls'] is False


def test_learning_domains_unchanged():
    domains = settings.LEARNING_CONFIG['domains']
    assert 'LoRA微调' in domains
    assert 'RLHF训练' in domains
    assert len(domains) == 10
